Use case: text-localization. Edit target: the attached Russian time-management app screenshot. Produce an English localized version of THIS SAME screenshot for a bilingual portfolio, preserving the original 1520x722 aspect ratio, crop, layout, cream background, white panels, shadows, icons, colors, checkboxes, numbers, dates and all empty space. Change only visible text to natural English, matching the existing small sans-serif typography and text alignment. Preserve visible ellipses where text is truncated. Do not redesign, move cards, add features, remove content or add a watermark.
Translate the top input to "Do, save or plan...", "Завтра" to "Tomorrow", "До демо Атласа" to "Until Atlas demo", "Дата прошла" to "Date passed", "С начала проекта" to "Since project start", "40 дн." to "40 days", "Прогулка помог..." to "Walks help...", and language button RU to EN with a small UK flag.
Left panel: "Задачи" = "Tasks"; "Контент и личное" = "Content & personal"; "ГЛАВНОЕ:" = "MAIN FOCUS:"; "Довести Атлас до клиентского демо" = "Get Atlas ready for a client demo"; "ЗАМЕНА:" = "FOR A CHANGE:"; "Написать разбор ошибок поиска" = "Write a search-error analysis"; "23 ДН." = "23 DAYS". Four list rows: "Write a note: Why big...", "Record a short work video...", "Plan a phone-free walk...", "Sort saved articles...". Keep 10d badges.
Middle: "Сегодня" = "Today"; both occurrences of "Вечерняя запись итогов" = "Evening review"; "ЗАВТРА" = "TOMORROW".
Right: "Заметки" = "Notes"; "Редактор" = "Editor"; card category "КОНТЕНТ" = "CONTENT"; card heading "Эксперимент 07 · поиск + ранжирование" = "Experiment 07 · search + ranking"; warning text must read "DEMO NUMBERS, NOT A REAL BENCHMARK."; "Набор: 40 ..." = "Dataset: 40 ...". Second card category "АТЛАС" = "ATLAS"; heading "Атлас — план демо" = "Atlas — demo plan"; body "Goal: show how to find an answer in a document collection and check the source." Keep the trailing ellipsis and every displayed numeric date unchanged.
All text must be crisp and legible. Preserve the exact functional meaning. The main-focus task is the life-defining focus for the current period; the For a change task is a different activity for taking a break from that focus.
